    both_all['region'] = both_all['iso_code'].map(_ISO_REGION)
    regional = both_all.dropna(subset=['region']).groupby(['region', 'year'])['homicide_rate'].median().reset_index()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 5))
    region_colors = {'Americas': '#E74C3C', 'Africa': '#F39C12', 'Europe': '#2E86C1',
                     'Asia': '#27AE60', 'Oceania': '#8E44AD'}

    for region in ['Americas', 'Africa', 'Europe', 'Asia', 'Oceania']:
        rdata = regional[regional['region'] == region].sort_values('year')
        if len(rdata) > 0:
            ax.plot(rdata['year'], rdata['homicide_rate'], linewidth=2.2,
                    marker='o', markersize=3, label=region,
                    color=region_colors.get(region, COLORS['neutral']))

    ax.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax.set_ylabel('Median Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title('Regional Median Homicide Rate Trends', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold',
                 color=COLORS['text'], pad=15)
    ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True, facecolor='white', edgecolor=COLORS['border'])

    return fig_to_base64(fig)

def chart_gender_disparity(df):
    """Gender disparity analysis: male vs female rates over time and M/F ratio."""
    male_all = df[(df['sex'] == 'male') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    female_all = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

    male_yearly = male_all.groupby('year')['homicide_rate'].median()
    female_yearly = female_all.groupby('year')['homicide_rate'].median()

    # Merge for ratio
    mf = pd.merge(
        male_all[['country', 'year', 'homicide_rate']],
        female_all[['country', 'year', 'homicide_rate']],
        on=['country', 'year'], suffixes=('_male', '_female')
    )
    mf['ratio'] = mf['homicide_rate_male'] / mf['homicide_rate_female'].replace(0, np.nan)
    ratio_yearly = mf.groupby('year')['ratio'].median()

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

    # Left: Male vs Female median rates
    ax1.plot(male_yearly.index, male_yearly.values, color=COLORS['male'], linewidth=2.5,
             marker='o', markersize=3, label='Male')
    ax1.plot(female_yearly.index, female_yearly.values, color=COLORS['female'], linewidth=2.5,
             marker='s', markersize=3, label='Female')

def chart_notable_trends(df):
    """Countries with the most dramatic changes in homicide rates."""
    both_all = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

    # Compute change for countries with data in both early (1990-1995) and late (2018-2023) periods
    early = both_all[both_all['year'].between(1990, 1995)].groupby('country')['homicide_rate'].mean()
    late = both_all[both_all['year'].between(2018, 2023)].groupby('country')['homicide_rate'].mean()

    changes = pd.DataFrame({'early': early, 'late': late}).dropna()
    changes['abs_change'] = changes['late'] - changes['early']
    changes['pct_change'] = (changes['late'] - changes['early']) / changes['early'].replace(0, np.nan) * 100

    # Top improvers (largest decrease) and top deteriorators (largest increase)
    # Filter to countries with meaningful early rates (> 1.0)
    meaningful = changes[changes['early'] > 1.0]
    top_improvers = meaningful.nsmallest(8, 'abs_change')
    top_deteriorators = meaningful.nlargest(8, 'abs_change')

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.5))

    # Top improvers
    ax1.barh(range(len(top_improvers)), top_improvers['abs_change'].values,
             color=COLORS['success'], alpha=0.85, height=0.65)
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_improvers)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(top_improvers.index, fontsize=9)
    ax1.set_xlabel('Change in Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax1.set_title('Largest Improvements (Decline)', fontsize=12,
                  fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['success'])
    ax1.invert_yaxis()
    ax1.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
    for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(top_improvers.iterrows()):
        ax1.text(row['abs_change'] - 0.3, i, f'{row["abs_change"]:.1f}',
                 va='center', ha='right', fontsize=8, color='white', fontweight='bold')

    # Top deteriorators
    ax2.barh(range(len(top_deteriorators)), top_deteriorators['abs_change'].values,
             color=COLORS['danger'], alpha=0.85, height=0.65)
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(top_deteriorators)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(top_deteriorators.index, fontsize=9)
    ax2.set_xlabel('Change in Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax2.set_title('Largest Deteriorations (Increase)', fontsize=12,
                  fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['danger'])
    ax2.invert_yaxis()
    ax2.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
    for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(top_deteriorators.iterrows()):
        ax2.text(row['abs_change'] - 0.3, i, f'{row["abs_change"]:.1f}',
                 va='center', ha='right', fontsize=8, color='white', fontweight='bold')

    fig.suptitle('Notable Country-Level Changes (Early 1990s vs. 2018–2023)',
                 fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['text'], y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_base64(fig)

def get_regional_latest(df, kpis):
    """Get regional median rates for the most recent year."""
    recent = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL') &
                (df['year'] == kpis['most_recent_year'])].copy()
    recent['region'] = recent['iso_code'].map(_ISO_REGION)
    return recent.dropna(subset=['region']).groupby('region')['homicide_rate'].agg(
        ['median', 'mean', 'count']).sort_values('median', ascending=False)


def get_gender_by_country(df, kpis):
    """Get gender disparity for selected high-profile countries."""
    male = df[(df['sex'] == 'male') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    female = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

    # Use most recent year with data
    recent_year = kpis['most_recent_year']

    male_recent = male[male['year'] == recent_year][['country', 'homicide_rate']].rename(
        columns={'homicide_rate': 'male_rate'})
    female_recent = female[female['year'] == recent_year][['country', 'homicide_rate']].rename(
        columns={'homicide_rate': 'female_rate'})

    merged = pd.merge(male_recent, female_recent, on='country')
    merged['ratio'] = merged['male_rate'] / merged['female_rate'].replace(0, np.nan)
    return merged.sort_values('ratio', ascending=False).head(10)


def get_age_risk_ranking(df):
    """Rank age groups by homicide risk."""
    age_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] != 'ALL')].copy()
    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']
    age_data = age_data[age_data['age_group'].isin(age_order)]
    result = age_data.groupby('age_group')['homicide_rate'].agg(['median', 'mean', 'count'])
    result = result.reindex(age_order)
    result.index = age_labels
    return result

def chart_top_bottom_countries(kpis):
    """Top 10 and Bottom 10 countries by homicide rate in most recent year."""
    recent = kpis['recent_data'].sort_values('homicide_rate', ascending=False)
    top10 = recent.head(10)
    bottom10 = recent[recent['homicide_rate'] > 0].tail(10).sort_values('homicide_rate')

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.5))

    # Top 10
    bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(top10)), top10['homicide_rate'].values,
                      color=COLORS['danger'], alpha=0.85, edgecolor='white', height=0.65)
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top10)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(top10['country'].values, fontsize=9)
    ax1.invert_yaxis()
    ax1.set_xlabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax1.set_title(f'Highest Homicide Rates ({kpis["most_recent_year"]})',
                  fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['text'])
    ax1.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
    for bar, val in zip(bars1, top10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax1.text(val + 0.3, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}',
                 va='center', fontsize=8, color=COLORS['text'])

    # Bottom 10
    bars2 = ax2.barh(range(len(bottom10)), bottom10['homicide_rate'].values,
                      color=COLORS['success'], alpha=0.85, edgecolor='white', height=0.65)
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(bottom10)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(bottom10['country'].values, fontsize=9)
    ax2.invert_yaxis()
    ax2.set_xlabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax2.set_title(f'Lowest Homicide Rates ({kpis["most_recent_year"]})',
                  fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['text'])
    ax2.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
    for bar, val in zip(bars2, bottom10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax2.text(val + 0.05, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.2f}',
                 va='center', fontsize=8, color=COLORS['text'])

    fig.suptitle('Country-Level Homicide Rate Extremes', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold',
                 color=COLORS['text'], y=1.02)
    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_base64(fig)

    """Age group analysis of homicide rates."""
    # Use sex=both for age groups (not ALL)
    age_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] != 'ALL')].copy()

    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']

    age_data = age_data[age_data['age_group'].isin(age_order)]

    age_median = age_data.groupby('age_group')['homicide_rate'].median().reindex(age_order)

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('/app/benchmark/data.csv')

# Verify key KPIs
both_all = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

# Most recent year with >= 80 countries
year_counts = both_all.groupby('year')['country'].nunique()
recent_years = year_counts[year_counts >= 80].index.sort_values()
most_recent = int(recent_years[-1])
recent = both_all[both_all['year'] == most_recent]

print('=== KPI Verification ===')
print(f'Most recent year (>=80 countries): {most_recent}')
print(f'Countries reporting: {len(recent)}')
print(f'Global median rate: {recent[\"homicide_rate\"].median():.2f}')
print(f'Global mean rate: {recent[\"homicide_rate\"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'Highest rate: {recent[\"homicide_rate\"].max():.2f} ({recent.loc[recent[\"homicide_rate\"].idxmax(), \"country\"]})')
print(f'Lowest rate: {recent[\"homicide_rate\"].min():.2f} ({recent.loc[recent[\"homicide_rate\"].idxmin(), \"country\"]})')

# Male/Female ratio
male_all = df[(df['sex'] == 'male') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
female_all = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
mf = pd.merge(male_all[['country','year','homicide_rate']], female_all[['country','year','homicide_rate']], on=['country','year'], suffixes=('_m','_f'))
mf['ratio'] = mf['homicide_rate_m'] / mf['homicide_rate_f'].replace(0, float('nan'))
print(f'M/F ratio median: {mf[\"ratio\"].median():.1f}x')

# Decade changes
both_all_copy = both_all.copy()
both_all_copy['decade'] = (both_all_copy['year'] // 10) * 10
d = both_all_copy.groupby('decade')['homicide_rate'].mean()
print(f'Decade means: 1990s={d.get(1990,0):.1f} 2000s={d.get(2000,0):.1f} 2010s={d.get(2010,0):.1f} 2020s={d.get(2020,0):.1f}')
print(f'Change 90s->00s: {((d.get(2000,0)-d.get(1990,0))/d.get(1990,0)*100):.1f}%')
print(f'Change 00s->10s: {((d.get(2010,0)-d.get(2000,0))/d.get(2000,0)*100):.1f}%')
print(f'Change 10s->20s: {((d.get(2020,0)-d.get(2010,0))/d.get(2010,0)*100):.1f}%')

# Coverage
total = df['country'].nunique()
cov = both_all.groupby('year')['country'].nunique() / total * 100
print(f'Avg coverage: {cov.mean():.0f}%, Latest (2023): {cov.get(2023,0):.0f}%')
"

female_all = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
mf = pd.merge(male_all[['country','year','homicide_rate']], female_all[['country','year','homicide_rate']], on=['country','year'], suffixes=('_m','_f'))
mf['ratio'] = mf['homicide_rate_m'] / mf['homicide_rate_f'].replace(0, float('nan'))
print(f'M/F ratio median: {mf[\"ratio\"].median():.1f}x')

# Decade changes
both_all_copy = both_all.copy()
both_all_copy['decade'] = (both_all_copy['year'] // 10) * 10
d = both_all_copy.groupby('decade')['homicide_rate'].mean()
print(f'Decade means: 1990s={d.get(1990,0):.1f} 2000s={d.get(2000,0):.1f} 2010s={d.get(2010,0):.1f} 2020s={d.get(2020,0):.1f}')
print(f'Change 90s->00s: {((d.get(2000,0)-d.get(1990,0))/d.get(1990,0)*100):.1f}%')
print(f'Change 00s->10s: {((d.get(2010,0)-d.get(2000,0))/d.get(2000,0)*100):.1f}%')
print(f'Change 10s->20s: {((d.get(2020,0)-d.get(2010,0))/d.get(2010,0)*100):.1f}%')

# Coverage
total = df['country'].nunique()
cov = both_all.groupby('year')['country'].nunique() / total * 100
print(f'Avg coverage: {cov.mean():.0f}%, Latest (2023): {cov.get(2023,0):.0f}%')
"
